plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the animated series specials in and . DVD releases are for . All releases are , except the DVD release of Mewtwo Returns which is .

==Pokémon Chronicles==
 

==Dedicated releases==
===Mewtwo Returns===
Mewtwo Returns was released by on home video in Australia on both VHS and DVD. It was released on VHS in Australia with the catalogue number 22141. It was released on DVD in Australia with the catalogue number DVS22142.

The DVD includes English, French and Spanish audio, with optional English, French and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD includes the following extras:
The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin
"Born to Be a Winner"
Trailers of the first three Pokémon movies

 

===Pokémon Origins===
Pokémon Origins was released by on home video in Australia on DVD. It was released on DVD in Australia on April 28, 2014 and in New Zealand on May 21, 2014 with the catalogue number BHE5430.

 

==As bonus content==
===Pikachu shorts===
Pikachu shorts are occasionally included in the same release as Pokémon movies on VHS and DVD. While this was originally only done for relases and some releases, Pikachu shorts are also included on the releases Pokémon: Movies 1-3 Gold Edition and Pokémon: Movies 1-3 Collection.
 

===The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon===
 
The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon was included as a bonus feature in the Super Wallet release for Pokémon: Battle Frontier. It was released in Australia on March 4, 2009 and its catalogue number is DSW12994.

 

===Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness===
 
Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness was included on a bonus disc in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl - Collection 2. It was released in Australia on May 6, 2009 and its catalogue number is DBX13066.
